title: TSMC July 2026 Revenue Report
text:
Daniel Nenni
Founder
Staff member

TSMC reported another record-setting month in July 2026 as demand for advanced semiconductors continued to support rapid growth. The Taiwanese chipmaker generated consolidated net revenue of approximately NT$467.58 billion, representing a 44.7% increase from July 2025.

The monthly result extended TSMC’s strong momentum after June revenue reached NT$442.68 billion. July’s sequential improvement indicates that customer demand remained robust as the company entered the third quarter. It also lifted cumulative revenue for January through July to NT$2.872 trillion, 37.0% higher than during the corresponding period in 2025.

The figures reinforce TSMC’s position as the leading manufacturer of advanced chips used in artificial intelligence accelerators, high-performance computing systems, smartphones, and other electronic products. Strong orders for leading-edge process technologies have helped the company benefit from expanding investment in AI infrastructure and data centers. July’s year-over-year growth notably exceeded the 25.8% increase recorded in July 2025, demonstrating a substantial acceleration in the company’s sales trajectory.

Despite the positive report, monthly revenue alone does not reveal profitability, product mix, manufacturing costs, or currency effects. Investors will therefore look to TSMC’s third-quarter earnings for further evidence regarding margins, capacity utilization, capital expenditure, and demand sustainability.

Overall, the July report signals a powerful start to the third quarter. Continued sequential growth from an already elevated June base, combined with a 37.0% cumulative increase, suggests that TSMC remains firmly positioned to deliver exceptional revenue growth in 2026 this year.

HSINCHU, Taiwan, R.O.C. – August 10, 2026 - TSMC (TWSE: 2330, NYSE: TSM) today announced its net revenue for July 2026: On a consolidated basis, revenue for July 2026 was approximately NT$467.58 billion, an increase of 5.6 percent from June 2026 and an increase of 44.7 percent from July 2025. Revenue for January through July 2026 totaled NT$2,872.06 billion, an increase of 37.0 percent compared to the same period in 2025.
